    tapes (fun _ => 0) (splitRestoreScan 0 w s 0)
    (Cfg.ofWords (4, false) (stateWord 1 (splitStep w s))) t
    (by intro j hj q hq he; subst q; exact hf j hj hq) hr
  rw [emitterP2_advance_initial, emitterP2_stateWord_one] at h
  dsimp only [tapes] at h
  erw [emitterP2_one_frame, emitterP2_one_frame,
    emitterP2_update_candidate, emitterP2_update_candidate] at h
  exact ⟨t, ht, h⟩

/-- The payload emitter's complete one-tape entry is the clean candidate seam. -/
private lemma emitterP2_emit_initial (w s : List Bool) :
    splitEmitCfg 0 w s (some 0) 0 0 [] = Cfg.ofWords 0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => s) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl
  · simp [splitEmitCfg, Cfg.ofWords, splitPos]
  · funext i; fin_cases i; rfl
  · funext i; fin_cases i; rfl

/-- Acceptance emits the split of the preserved native input, never the
candidate's bits. The exact emitter entry includes input head one and every
work head zero; unrelated banks remain blank throughout.
**Proof sketch.** Use the existing emitter at zero scratch tapes and relocate its sole candidate tape. Its full entry equality and native-input semantics give the stated payload and halt; disjoint emission control excludes the anchor. -/
private lemma emitterP2_body_emit (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s : List Bool) (hs : s.length ≤ w.length) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.emit 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])
    (B.tm.runFrom z (s.length + w.length + 3)).state = none ∧
      (B.tm.runFrom z (s.length + w.length + 3)).output =
        pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor z (s.length + w.length + 3) := by
  dsimp only
  let emb : Fin 4 ↪ EmitterP2State C.State D.State :=
    ⟨.emit, by intro a b h; exact EmitterP2State.emit.inj h⟩
  let tapes := fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words C.k D.k [] [] [] i)
  have h := emitterP2_phase (splitEmitTM 0).tm (emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx).tm
    (emitterP2OneIndex (0 : Fin (C.k + D.k + 1))) emb .anchor (by intro q; simp [emb]) (fun _ => True)
    (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) tapes (fun _ => 0)
    (splitEmitCfg 0 w s (some 0) 0 0 [])
    (splitEmitCfg 0 w s none w.length s.length (pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)))
    (s.length + w.length + 3) (by intros; trivial) (splitEmit_run 0 w s hs)
  rw [emitterP2_emit_initial] at h
  dsimp only [tapes] at h
  erw [emitterP2_one_frame, emitterP2_update_candidate] at h
  exact ⟨congrArg Cfg.state h.1, congrArg Cfg.output h.1, h.2⟩
/-- Extend a safe phase by one silent dispatch to another non-anchor phase. -/
private lemma emitterP2_after {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c : Cfg k Bool S w)
    (t : ℕ) (q r : S) (words : Fin k → List Bool)
    (hr : tm.runFrom c t = Cfg.ofWords q words) (hs : splitSafe tm anchor c t)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = controlAction 0 (some r))
    (hq : q ≠ anchor) (hnext : r ≠ anchor) :
    tm.runFrom c (t + 1) = Cfg.ofWords r words ∧ splitSafe tm anchor c (t + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨he, hse⟩ := splitSafe_one tm anchor (Cfg.ofWords q words) (Cfg.ofWords r words)
    (emitterP2_control tm q r htr w words)
    (by simpa only [Cfg.ofWords, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq] using hq)
    (by simpa only [Cfg.ofWords, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq] using hnext)
  exact splitSafe_join tm anchor c _ _ t 1 hr hs he hse

/-- The two clean calls and comparison form one safe testing segment. Both
calls are charged before assuming any relation between their results.
**Proof sketch.** Concatenate the unconditional first-step calls and whole-word comparison with four explicit silent dispatches. Each complete frame is the next phase entry; the sum of their bounds includes both evaluator traces before testing equality. -/
private lemma emitterP2_body_test (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hfC : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < a → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hrC : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) a =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k u))
    (hfD : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < b → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hrD : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) b =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k v)) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (8, false))
      (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length))
    ∃ t ≤ a + b + 2 * (max u.length v.length + 1) + 4,
      B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords (.eraseLeft (decide (u = v)) 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v) ∧ splitSafe B.tm .anchor z t := by
  dsimp only
  let tm := (emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx).tm
  let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (EmitterP2State.prepare (S := C.State) (T := D.State) (8, false))
    (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length))
  have hzsafe : splitSafe tm .anchor z 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hz : j = 0 := by omega
    subst j
    simp [z, Cfg.ofWords]
  obtain ⟨h0, hs0⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor z 0 (.prepare (8, false)) .widthStart _ rfl hzsafe
    (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hE, hsE⟩ := emitterP2_body_width C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s u (w.drop s.length) a ha hfC hrC
  obtain ⟨h1, hs1⟩ := splitSafe_join tm .anchor z _ _ 1 a h0 hs0 hE hsE
  obtain ⟨h2, hs2⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor z (1 + a) (.width cx) .lengthStart _ h1 hs1
    (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hL, hsL⟩ := emitterP2_body_length C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s u (w.drop s.length) v b hb hfD hrD
  obtain ⟨h3, hs3⟩ := splitSafe_join tm .anchor z _ _ (1 + a + 1) b h2 hs2 hL hsL
  obtain ⟨h4, hs4⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor z (1 + a + 1 + b) (.length dx) (.compare (0, true)) _ h3 hs3
    (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hQ, hsQ⟩ := emitterP2_body_compare C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s u v
  obtain ⟨h5, hs5⟩ := splitSafe_join tm .anchor z _ _ (1 + a + 1 + b + 1) c h4 hs4 hQ hsQ
  obtain ⟨h6, hs6⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor z (1 + a + 1 + b + 1 + c)
    (.compare (2, decide (u = v))) (.eraseLeft (decide (u = v)) 0) _ h5 hs5
    (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
  exact ⟨1 + a + 1 + b + 1 + c + 1, by omega, h6, hs6⟩

/-- Cleanup and final dispatch close either branch at its literal target.
**Proof sketch.** Erase each installed word and retain the verdict in control.
Acceptance enters the complete native payload-emitter configuration. Rejection
runs the one-tape advance and makes one final silent anchor transition. Its
strict-interior exclusion includes every cleanup, rewind, and dispatch. -/
private lemma emitterP2_body_finish (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool)
    (hok : ok = true → s.length ≤ w.length) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseLeft ok 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * u.length + 2 * v.length + 2 * s.length + w.length + 12,
      (∀ j < t, (B.tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if ok then
        (B.tm.runFrom z t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom z t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k (splitStep w s) [] []) := by
  dsimp only
  let tm := (emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx).tm
  let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (EmitterP2State.eraseLeft (S := C.State) (T := D.State) ok 0)
    (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h1, hs1⟩ := emitterP2_body_erase_left C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s u v ok
  obtain ⟨h2, hs2⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor z a (.eraseLeft ok 2) (.eraseRight ok 0) _ h1 hs1
    (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hR, hsR⟩ := emitterP2_body_erase_right C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s [] v ok
  obtain ⟨h3, hs3⟩ := splitSafe_join tm .anchor z _ _ (a + 1) b h2 hs2 hR hsR
  cases ok with
  | false =>
    obtain ⟨h4, hs4⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor z (a + 1 + b)
      (.eraseRight false 2) (.advance (0, false)) _ h3 hs3
      (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hA, hsA⟩ := emitterP2_body_advance C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s
    obtain ⟨h5, hs5⟩ := splitSafe_join tm .anchor z _ _ (a + 1 + b + 1) c h4 hs4 hA hsA
    have he := emitterP2_control tm (.advance (4, false)) .anchor
      (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) w
      (emitterP2Words C.k D.k (splitStep w s) [] [])
    refine ⟨a + 1 + b + 1 + c + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj; exact hs5 j (by omega)
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      change tm.runFrom z (a + 1 + b + 1 + c + 1) = _
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', h5, he]
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨h4, hs4⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor z (a + 1 + b)
      (.eraseRight true 2) (.emit 0) _ h3 hs3
      (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨he, ho, hse⟩ := emitterP2_body_emit C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s (hok rfl)
    have hsall : splitSafe tm .anchor z (a + 1 + b + 1 + (s.length + w.length + 3)) := by
      apply splitSafe_add tm .anchor z (a + 1 + b + 1) (s.length + w.length + 3) hs4
      rw [h4]; exact hse
    refine ⟨a + 1 + b + 1 + (s.length + w.length + 3), by omega,
      fun j hj => hsall j (by omega), ?_⟩
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    change (tm.runFrom z _).state = none ∧ _
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h4]
    exact ⟨he, ho⟩
/-- A safe prefix followed by a strictly safe terminal segment remains away
from the anchor before its final time, even when that final time returns. -/
private lemma emitterP2_strict_join {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (a b : ℕ)
    (hr : tm.runFrom c a = d) (hs : splitSafe tm anchor c a)
    (hf : ∀ j < b, (tm.runFrom d j).state ≠ some anchor) :
    ∀ j < a + b, (tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some anchor := by
  intro j hj
  by_cases hja : j ≤ a
  · exact hs j hja
  · rw [show j = a + (j - a) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hr]
    exact hf (j - a) (by omega)

/-- Full native round, parameterized by the two actual clean-call traces.
**Proof sketch.** Depart the anchor, prepare the exact two arguments, and
branch on the observed past-end flag. The past-end branch erases preparation
and returns silently. Otherwise run both calls before comparing their entire
binary answers. The verdict survives cleanup; the finish theorem emits the
native split or advances to the exact canonical seam. Every interior phase
excludes the anchor, and the one-step departure makes every round positive. -/
private lemma emitterP2_body_round (f : ℕ → ℕ) (C D : FinTM Bool)
    (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k) (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State)
    (w s : List Bool) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hfC : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < a → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hrC : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) a =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k (Nat.bits (f s.length))))
    (hfD : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < b → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hrD : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) b =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length))) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + (Nat.bits (f s.length)).length +
        (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length).length + 10) ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (B.tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
        (B.tm.runFrom z t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom z t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k (splitStep w s)) := by
  dsimp only
  let tm := (emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx).tm
  let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (EmitterP2State.anchor (S := C.State) (T := D.State))
    (stateWord (C.k + D.k + 1) s)
  let p := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (EmitterP2State.prepare (S := C.State) (T := D.State) (0, false))
    (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])
  have hdepart : tm.runFrom z 1 = p := by
    change tm.step z = p
    simpa only [z, p, emitterP2_words_clean] using emitterP2_control tm .anchor (.prepare (0, false))
      (fun _ _ => rfl) w (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hp, hps⟩ := emitterP2_body_prepare C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s
  by_cases hover : w.length < s.length
  · have hp' : tm.runFrom p c = Cfg.ofWords (.prepare (8, true))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length)) := by simpa [hover] using hp
    obtain ⟨h2, hs2⟩ := emitterP2_after tm .anchor p c (.prepare (8, true)) (.eraseLeft false 0)
      _ hp' hps (by intro inp work; simp [tm, emitterP2BodyTM]) (by simp) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hds, hfinish⟩ := emitterP2_body_finish C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s s
      (w.drop s.length) false (by simp)
    have hstrict := emitterP2_strict_join tm .anchor p _ (c + 1) d h2 hs2 hds
    have hrun : tm.runFrom z (1 + (c + 1 + d)) = tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (.eraseLeft false 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length))) d := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hdepart, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h2]
    refine ⟨1 + (c + 1 + d), by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hv : (w.drop s.length).length ≤ w.length := by simp only [List.length_drop]; omega
      omega
    · intro j hj hjt
      change (tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ _
      rw [show j = 1 + (j - 1) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hdepart]
      exact hstrict (j - 1) (by omega)
    · have hn : s.length + f s.length ≠ w.length := by omega
      simp only [emitterSplitAccept, hn, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      change tm.runFrom z (1 + (c + 1 + d)) = _
      rw [hrun]
      simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, emitterP2_words_clean] using hfinish
  · have hs : s.length ≤ w.length := by omega
    have hp' : tm.runFrom p c = Cfg.ofWords (.prepare (8, false))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length)) := by simpa [hover] using hp
    let u := Nat.bits (f s.length)
    let v := Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length
    obtain ⟨d, hd, htest, htests⟩ := emitterP2_body_test C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s u v
      a b ha hb hfC hrC hfD hrD
    obtain ⟨h2, hs2⟩ := splitSafe_join tm .anchor p _ _ c d hp' hps htest htests
    obtain ⟨e, he, hes, hfinish⟩ := emitterP2_body_finish C D hk hl ce cx de dx w s u v
      (decide (u = v)) (fun _ => hs)
    have hstrict := emitterP2_strict_join tm .anchor p _ (c + d) e h2 hs2 hes
    have hrun : tm.runFrom z (1 + (c + d + e)) = tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (.eraseLeft (decide (u = v)) 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) e := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hdepart, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h2]
    have hok : decide (u = v) = emitterSplitAccept f w s := by
      apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
      simpa only [u, v, emitterSplitAccept, decide_eq_true_eq] using emitter_binary_check f w s hs
    refine ⟨1 + (c + d + e), by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hm : max u.length v.length ≤ u.length + v.length := max_le (by omega) (by omega)
      change 1 + (c + d + e) ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10)
      omega
    · intro j hj hjt
      change (tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ _
      rw [show j = 1 + (j - 1) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hdepart]
      exact hstrict (j - 1) (by omega)
    · change if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
        (tm.runFrom z (1 + (c + d + e))).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom z (1 + (c + d + e))).output = _
        else tm.runFrom z (1 + (c + d + e)) = _
      rw [hrun]
      simpa only [hok, emitterP2_words_clean] using hfinish
/-- Extract the two clean-call modules once, fix their layout, and close the
frozen split contract through the existing result-bearing loop.
**Proof sketch.** Apply the width evaluator only to the actual candidate and
the length evaluator only to the actual native suffix. Bound each returned
word by its own evaluator deadline, then enlarge those analysis bounds to
the common input-length envelope. The concrete round theorem supplies every
canonical endpoint and strict-interior exclusion. Neither deadline occurs in
the controller; dispatch follows the proved first-positive return instead. -/
private lemma emitterP2_closed (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool) (TE : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hTE : Monotone TE) (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
        | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) := by
  obtain ⟨L, d, hL⟩ := computesFunInTime_lengthBits
  obtain ⟨C, ce, cx, cC, hk, hC⟩ :=
    exists_installCallTM E (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE hE
  obtain ⟨D, de, dx, cD, hl, hD⟩ :=
    exists_installCallTM L (fun s => Nat.bits s.length) (fun n => d * (n + 1)) hL
  let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
  let A := 2 * cC + cD * (2 * d + 1) + 10 * (d + 8)
  apply emitterSplit_of_body f TE B .anchor A
  · intro w
    refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj; omega
    · exact emitterP2_body_start C D hk hl ce cx de dx w
  · intro w s hs
    let H := TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2
    let u := Nat.bits (f s.length)
    let v := Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length
    obtain ⟨_, hu, hmono⟩ := emitter_width_budget f E TE hTE hE w s hs
    have hdrop : (w.drop s.length).length ≤ w.length := by simp only [List.length_drop]; omega
    have hv : v.length ≤ d * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) := by
      have hout := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hL (w.drop s.length))).2
      simpa only [hout, v] using L.tm.output_length_le (w.drop s.length)
        (d * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1))
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hap, haf, har⟩ := hC w s
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbp, hbf, hbr⟩ := hD w (w.drop s.length)
    obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hfirst, hr⟩ := emitterP2_body_round f C D hk hl ce cx de dx
      w s a b hap hbp haf har hbf hbr
    refine ⟨t, htpos, ?_, hfirst, hr⟩
    have hHs : s.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHn : w.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHu : u.length ≤ H := by dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hHfive : 10 ≤ 5 * H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hLd : d * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) ≤ d * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (by dsimp [H]; omega)
    have hHv : v.length ≤ d * H := hv.trans hLd
    have hCa : TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1 ≤ 2 * H := by
      dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hCa' : a ≤ (2 * cC) * H := by
      calc
        a ≤ cC * (TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1) := ha
        _ ≤ cC * (2 * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hCa
        _ = (2 * cC) * H := by ring
    have hDb : d * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1 ≤
        (2 * d + 1) * H := by
      calc
        _ ≤ 2 * (d * H) + H := by dsimp [H] at *; omega
        _ = (2 * d + 1) * H := by ring
    have hDb' : b ≤ (cD * (2 * d + 1)) * H := by
      calc
        b ≤ cD * (d * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1) := hb
        _ ≤ cD * ((2 * d + 1) * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hDb
        _ = (cD * (2 * d + 1)) * H := by ring
    have hsum : s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10 ≤ (d + 8) * H := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
      omega
    calc
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10) := ht
      _ ≤ (2 * cC) * H + (cD * (2 * d + 1)) * H + 10 * ((d + 8) * H) :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add hCa' hDb') (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsum)
      _ = A * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) := by dsimp [A, H]; ring

/-- **The width-parametric split search's time**. If `E` computes `s ↦ Nat.bits (f |s|)` within a
monotone `TE`, the split search computes `w ↦ pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)` for the first
solution `i` of `i + f i = |w|` (`Turing.solveSplitWith`), and `[]` if there is none, within
`20·(591 + 26·k_E)·(n + 1)·(TE (n + 1) + n + 2)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** Today's `emitterP2_closed` and `emitterSplit_of_body` with every existential
named: the clean calls cost `(24 + 13·k_E)` and `(24 + 13·1)` times their arguments
(`callTM_run`), the round coefficient is `A = 2(24 + 13·k_E) + 37·11 + 10·13 = 585 + 26·k_E`
(`emitterP2_body_round`, `emitter_width_budget`), the counter's `5` enlarges it, and
`emitterSplit_loop_bound` turns the find loop's `10·(T n + 1)·(n + 2)` into
`2·10·(A + 6)·(n + 1)·(TE (n + 1) + n + 2)`. -/
theorem splitSolveWithTM_computes (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool) (TE : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hTE : Monotone TE) (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    (splitSolveWithTM E).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
        | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 20 * (591 + 26 * E.k) * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) := by
  let C := callTM E false
  let D := callTM lengthBitsTM false
  let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D (callTM_k_pos E false) (callTM_k_pos lengthBitsTM false)
    (callEntry E false) (callExit E false) (callEntry lengthBitsTM false)
    (callExit lengthBitsTM false)
  let A := 2 * (24 + 13 * E.k) + (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1) + 10 * (5 + 8)
  -- the install-call contracts of the two named calls, from `callTM_run`
  have hCall (M : FinTM Bool) (g : List Bool → List Bool) (Tg : ℕ → ℕ)
      (hg : M.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (x arg : List Bool) :
      ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (Tg arg.length + arg.length + (g arg).length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → ((callTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k arg))
            t').state ≠ some (callExit M false)) ∧
        (callTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k arg)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords (callExit M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k (g arg)) := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hr⟩ := callTM_run M false x arg (g arg) (Tg arg.length) (hg arg)
    exact ⟨t, ht, hpos, fun j _ hj => hfirst j hj, by simpa using hr⟩
  have hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ (A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2),
      (∀ t' < t, (B.tm.runFrom (B.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      B.tm.runFrom (B.tm.initCfg w) t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k []) := fun w =>
    ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
      emitterP2_body_start C D _ _ _ _ _ _ w⟩
  have hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ (A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t').state
            ≠ some .anchor) ∧
        if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k (splitStep w s)) := by
    intro w s hs
    have hL := lengthBitsTM_computes
    let H := TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2
    let u := Nat.bits (f s.length)
    let v := Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length
    obtain ⟨_, hu, hmono⟩ := emitter_width_budget f E TE hTE hE w s hs
    have hdrop : (w.drop s.length).length ≤ w.length := by
      simp only [List.length_drop]; omega
    have hv : v.length ≤ 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) := by
      have hout := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hL (w.drop s.length))).2
      simpa only [hout, v] using lengthBitsTM.tm.output_length_le (w.drop s.length)
        (5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1))
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hap, haf, har⟩ := hCall E (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE hE w s
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbp, hbf, hbr⟩ :=
      hCall lengthBitsTM (fun s => Nat.bits s.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1)) hL w
        (w.drop s.length)
    obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hfirst, hr⟩ := emitterP2_body_round f C D _ _ _ _ _ _
      w s a b hap hbp haf har hbf hbr
    refine ⟨t, htpos, ?_, hfirst, hr⟩
    have hHs : s.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHn : w.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHu : u.length ≤ H := by dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hLd : 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) ≤ 5 * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 (by dsimp [H]; omega)
    have hHv : v.length ≤ 5 * H := hv.trans hLd
    have hCa : TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1 ≤ 2 * H := by
      dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hCa' : a ≤ (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H := by
      calc
        a ≤ (24 + 13 * E.k) * (TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1) := ha
        _ ≤ (24 + 13 * E.k) * (2 * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hCa
        _ = (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H := by ring
    have hDb : 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1 ≤
        (2 * 5 + 1) * H := by
      dsimp [H] at *; omega
    have hDb' : b ≤ ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H := by
      calc
        b ≤ (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) *
            (5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1) :=
          hb
        _ ≤ (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * ((2 * 5 + 1) * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hDb
        _ = ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H := by ring
    have hsum : s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10 ≤ (5 + 8) * H := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
      omega
    calc
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10) := ht
      _ ≤ (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H + ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H +
          10 * ((5 + 8) * H) :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add hCa' hDb') (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsum)
      _ = A * H := by dsimp [A]; ring
      _ ≤ (A + 5) * H := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hF : lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => Nat.bits (id w.length))
      (fun n => (A + 5) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) := by
    intro w
    refine (lengthBitsTM_computes w).mono ?_
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 (by omega : w.length + 1 ≤
      TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2)).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega))
  have hM := loopHostTM_finds B lengthBitsTM .anchor
    (fun w s => s.length ≤ w.length + 1) splitStep (emitterSplitAccept f)
    (fun w s => pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) (fun _ => [])
    id (fun n => (A + 5) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) hF (by intro w; simp) splitStep_inv
    hstart hround
  intro w
  have hm := hM w
  dsimp only [id_eq] at hm
  have hb : 10 * ((A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) + 1) * (w.length + 2) ≤
      20 * (591 + 26 * E.k) * (w.length + 1) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) :=
    (emitterSplit_loop_bound 10 (A + 5) w.length (TE (w.length + 1))).trans
      (le_of_eq (by simp only [A, show lengthBitsTM.k = 1 from rfl]; ring))
  convert hm.mono hb using 1
  exact (emitterSplit_result f w).symm

/-- **E4′, width-parametric split search** (design
§11; customers: 3A-cont's exponential padding equation — whose bespoke
body is this contract's harvest template — and every later padding
argument, including the ch3 hierarchy theorems). The generalization of
`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolve` from the hardwired polynomial
family to a hypothesis-supplied width evaluator: given a machine `E`
computing the binary representation of `f` of the input length within a
monotone budget `TE`, a machine solving `i + f i = n` by first-success
search, emitting the threaded split of the original input, and `[]` on
exhaustion, inside the loopFind envelope over `TE`. At
`f = fun i => C * (i + 1) ^ e` the computed function definitionally
recovers the catalog split's.

**Construction sketch.** The `exists_loopFindTM` engine with candidate
word as loop state: per round, run `E` on the prepared candidate prefix
with captured output (charging `TE` before any validity check), compare
whole canonical binary words against the suffix length, restore scratch,
advance by one; the one-past-end candidate takes a positive silent
stall. 3A-cont's displayed body contracts are exactly this round
discipline. -/
theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool)
    (TE : ℕ → ℕ) (hTE : Monotone TE)
    (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2) := by
  exact emitterP2_closed f E TE hTE hE

/-- **The unary token splitter**. A machine with no work tapes that, in one left-to-right scan,
emits the leading unary token of its input (the `true`s up to and including the first `false`)
doubled, then the pair separator, then the rest of the input, so that it outputs `pairEncode` of
`Turing.unaryTokenSplit x`. -/
def unaryTokenTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Fin 6
  tm :=
    { q₀ := 0
      tr := fun q inp _ => match q.val with
        | 0 => match inp with
          | some b => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some (if b then 1 else 2)⟩
          | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some false, some 4⟩
        | 1 => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some true, some 0⟩
        | 2 => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some false, some 3⟩
        | 3 => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some false, some 4⟩
        | 4 => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some true, some 5⟩
        | _ => match inp with
          | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some 5⟩
          | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩ }

/-- Two token transitions double the next bit and advance the input once;
only a false bit ends token scanning. -/
private lemma emitterToken_double (x pre rest out : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
      (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out) 2 =
      scanCfg x (some (if b then (0 : Fin 6) else 3)) (pre ++ [b]).length
        (by simp [hx]) (out ++ [b, b]) := by
  have hlen : pre.length < x.length := by simp [hx]
  have hread : x[pre.length]? = some b := by simp [hx]
  have hfirst : unaryTokenTM.tm.step
      (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by omega) out) =
      scanCfg x (some (if b then (1 : Fin 6) else 2)) pre.length (by omega)
        (out ++ [b]) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some (by rfl)]
    change (unaryTokenTM.tm.tr (0 : Fin 6) _ _).apply _ = _
    rw [scanCfg_read, hread]
    apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes <;> simp [unaryTokenTM, -Action.apply, Action.apply_state,
      Action.apply_inputPos, Action.apply_output, scanCfg]
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hfirst]
  simpa only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Option.toList_some,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using
    scanStep_right (S := Fin 6) unaryTokenTM.tm x (if b then 1 else 2)
      (some (if b then 0 else 3)) pre.length hlen (out ++ [b]) (some b)
      (by cases b <;> intros <;> rfl)

/-- The final separator row emits true and enters the suffix copier at the same input position. -/
private lemma emitterToken_separator_last (x out : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    unaryTokenTM.tm.step (scanCfg x (some (4 : Fin 6)) i hi out) =
      scanCfg x (some (5 : Fin 6)) i hi (out ++ [true]) := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some (by rfl)]
  apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes
  · exact Action.apply_state _ _
  · rw [Action.apply_inputPos]
    exact moveInputPos_zero _
  · exact Action.apply_output _ _

/-- The two separator transitions preserve the input position and append the
unique pair delimiter before entering the suffix copier.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the live-step equation twice and compare the state,
input position, and output after each write-free transition. -/
private lemma emitterToken_separator (x out : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some (3 : Fin 6)) i hi out) 2 =
      scanCfg x (some (5 : Fin 6)) i hi (out ++ [false, true]) := by
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
  let c₃ := scanCfg x (some (3 : Fin 6)) i hi out
  let c₄ := scanCfg x (some (4 : Fin 6)) i hi (out ++ [false])
  have h₃ : unaryTokenTM.tm.step c₃ = c₄ := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some (cfg := c₃) (q := (3 : Fin 6)) (by rfl)]
    apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes
    · exact Action.apply_state _ _
    · rw [Action.apply_inputPos]
      exact moveInputPos_zero _
    · exact Action.apply_output _ _
  change unaryTokenTM.tm.step (unaryTokenTM.tm.step c₃) = _
  rw [h₃]
  simpa only [c₄, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using
    emitterToken_separator_last x (out ++ [false]) i hi

/-- The streaming token encoder emits the exact recursive split, after any
already-consumed prefix. Its time is twice the token length plus the remainder
length plus three, including the final blank-reading halt.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the unconsumed input. At the right blank emit just
the separator. A false bit is doubled and terminates the token, so emit the
separator and copy the suffix. A true bit is doubled and the induction
hypothesis processes the remaining token. No standalone marker is consumed. -/
private lemma emitterToken_run (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
      unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out)
        (2 * (unaryTokenSplit rest).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit rest).2.length + 3) =
        scanCfg x none x.length (by omega)
          (out ++ pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit rest).1 (unaryTokenSplit rest).2) := by
  induction rest with
  | nil =>
    intro pre out hx
    have hlen : pre.length = x.length := by simp [hx]
    have hread : x[pre.length]? = none := by simp [hlen]
    simp only [unaryTokenSplit.eq_1, List.length_nil, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    have hfirst : unaryTokenTM.tm.step
        (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by omega) out) =
        scanCfg x (some (4 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by omega) (out ++ [false]) := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some (by rfl)]
      change (unaryTokenTM.tm.tr (0 : Fin 6) _ _).apply _ = _
      rw [scanCfg_read, hread]
      apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes <;> simp [unaryTokenTM, -Action.apply, Action.apply_state,
        Action.apply_inputPos, Action.apply_output, scanCfg]
    have hsep : unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by omega) out) 2 =
          scanCfg x (some (5 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by omega) ((out ++ [false]) ++ [true]) := by
      simp only [show (2 : ℕ) = (0 + 1) + 1 by rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hfirst]
      exact emitterToken_separator_last x (out ++ [false]) pre.length (by omega)
    rw [show (3 : ℕ) = (2 + (([] : List Bool).length + 1)) by rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hsep]
    have he := scanCopy_suffix (S := Fin 6) unaryTokenTM.tm 5 (fun _ _ => rfl)
      x [] pre ((out ++ [false]) ++ [true]) hx
    simpa [pairEncode_eq, List.append_assoc] using he
  | cons b rest ih =>
    intro pre out hx
    cases b with
    | false =>
      simp only [unaryTokenSplit.eq_2, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      rw [show 2 * (0 + 1) + rest.length + 3 = 2 + (2 + (rest.length + 1)) by omega,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, emitterToken_double x pre rest out false hx]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, emitterToken_separator]
      have he := scanCopy_suffix unaryTokenTM.tm (5 : Fin 6) (fun _ _ => rfl)
        x rest (pre ++ [false]) ((out ++ [false, false]) ++ [false, true])
        (by simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hx)
      simpa [pairEncode_eq, List.append_assoc] using he
    | true =>
      simp only [unaryTokenSplit.eq_3, List.length_cons]
      rw [show 2 * ((unaryTokenSplit rest).1.length + 1) +
          (unaryTokenSplit rest).2.length + 3 =
          2 + (2 * (unaryTokenSplit rest).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit rest).2.length + 3)
          by omega,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, emitterToken_double x pre rest out true hx]
      simp only [↓reduceIte]
      have he := ih (pre ++ [true]) (out ++ [true, true])
        (by simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hx)
      simpa [pairEncode_eq, List.append_assoc] using he

/-- Token and remainder partition every input, including empty and
unterminated tokens, so their lengths sum to the original length. -/
private lemma emitterToken_length (x : List Bool) :
    (unaryTokenSplit x).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit x).2.length = x.length := by
  induction x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b x ih => cases b <;> simp_all [unaryTokenSplit] <;> omega

/-- **The token splitter's time**. The splitter computes
`x ↦ pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit x).1 (unaryTokenSplit x).2` within `3·(n + 1)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The scan lemma `emitterToken_run` reaches the halt in `2·|token| + |rest| + 3`
steps from the initial configuration, and `|token| + |rest| = |x|` (`emitterToken_length`). -/
theorem unaryTokenTM_computes :
    unaryTokenTM.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit x).1 (unaryTokenSplit x).2)
      (fun n => 3 * (n + 1)) := by
  refine (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr fun x => ?_
  have hr := emitterToken_run x x [] [] rfl
  have hc : unaryTokenTM.ComputesInTime x
      (pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit x).1 (unaryTokenSplit x).2)
      (2 * (unaryTokenSplit x).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit x).2.length + 3) := by
    apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    have hinit : unaryTokenTM.tm.initCfg x =
        scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) 0 (by omega) [] := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq]
      apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes
      · rw [Cfg.init_state]
        rfl
      · rw [Cfg.init_inputPos]
        rfl
      · rw [Cfg.init_output]
        rfl
    rw [hinit]
    constructor
    · simpa only [List.length_nil, scanCfg] using congrArg Cfg.state hr
    · simpa only [List.length_nil, List.nil_append, scanCfg] using congrArg Cfg.output hr
  apply hc.mono
  have hl := emitterToken_length x
  omega

/-- **P16, the unary token step** (design §11;
customers: 3B-cont's streaming scanner, the Cook-Levin emitter's index
reads (4A), 4B's dual scanner — the fourth re-derivation of this atom
otherwise, after 2D's parsers, 3B's `satScanTM`, and 3D's six-state
scan). Split off the leading unary token (`Turing.unaryTokenSplit`) as a
self-delimiting pair, in linear time.

**Construction sketch.** One left-to-right scan emitting the token bits
as read, the delimiter, the pair framing, and the remainder — the proved
scanner stages of the 3B and 3D deliveries are the harvest sources. -/
theorem computesFunInTime_unaryToken :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit x).1 (unaryTokenSplit x).2)
        fun n => c * (n + 1) :=
  ⟨unaryTokenTM, 3, unaryTokenTM_computes⟩

/-- **The bit appender**. A machine with no work tapes that copies its input and emits the fixed bit
`b` on the halting transition, so that it computes `x ↦ x ++ [b]`. -/
def appendBitTM (b : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Unit
  tm :=
    { q₀ := ()
      tr := fun _ inp _ => match inp with
        | some a => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some a, some ()⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some b, none⟩ }

/-- Before the right blank, exactly the scanned prefix has been emitted.
After reading the initial configuration fields, apply
`scanCopy_run_of_symbol` to the symbol row. The emitting halt is still ahead. -/
private lemma emitterAppend_run (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
      (appendBitTM b).tm.runFrom ((appendBitTM b).tm.initCfg x) j =
        scanCfg x (some ()) j hj (x.take j) := by
  have hinit : (appendBitTM b).tm.initCfg x = scanCfg x (some ()) 0 (by omega) [] := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq]
    apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes <;>
      simp [-Cfg.init, Cfg.init_state, Cfg.init_inputPos, Cfg.init_output, scanCfg, appendBitTM]
  have htr (a : Bool) (work : Fin 0 → Option Bool) :
      (appendBitTM b).tm.tr () (some a) work =
        ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some a, some ()⟩ := rfl
  rw [hinit]
  simpa only [List.nil_append] using
    scanCopy_run_of_symbol (appendBitTM b).tm () htr x []

/-- **The bit appender's time**. On every input `x` the appender halts within `|x| + 1` steps with
output `x ++ [b]`.

**Proof sketch.** The copy invariant `emitterAppend_run` holds for `|x|` steps, and the next step
reads the blank, emits `b` and halts. -/
theorem appendBitTM_computes (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (appendBitTM b).ComputesInTime x (x ++ [b]) (x.length + 1) := by
  apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', emitterAppend_run b x x.length (by omega),
    MultiTapeTM.step_of_some rfl, scanCfg_read, List.getElem?_eq_none (le_refl _)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Action.apply_state]
    rfl
  · rw [Action.apply_output, List.take_length]
    rfl

/-- **P18′, append one bit** (design §11, narrowed at
spec time from the drafted accumulator row: cross-round persistence is the
loop engine's state-word mechanism, so the catalog atom is just the
append; customers: fresh-variable counters in 3B-cont and 4A, via the
loop state word). Append a single fixed bit to the input word, in linear
time.

**Construction sketch.** Copy the input verbatim, emit `b`, halt — P1's
copier with one extra emission on the halting transition. -/
theorem computesFunInTime_appendBit (b : Bool) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => x ++ [b]) fun n => c * (n + 1) :=
  ⟨appendBitTM b, 1, (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr fun x =>
    (appendBitTM_computes b x).mono (by omega)⟩

end Turing.FinTM
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Scan.lean =====

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Machine-construction library: constant writers and native-input sweeps (§12.8)

The single-sweep rows of the §12.8 rich-alphabet design
(`machine-library-design.md` §12.8a) that touch no G1-owned file: two writers
of a fixed word (R8.4, R8.4′) and two sweeps of the native input (R8.5a,
R8.5d). They are alphabet-generic, like the G1 catalog, and they are stated in
the §12.6 framed form: exact time, finish configuration, no earlier exit, and
the trajectory of every head, from an arbitrary configuration.

**Status: proved.** The four framed contracts are proved. The constant writer
and both native-input sweeps instantiate the public catalog trace; the cyclic
advancing writer uses one forward induction.

## Design

* **Two writers.** `Turing.writeConstTM` writes its word and returns the head,
  so it composes under `Turing.seamCompTM` like the R3 sweeps. The advancing
  writer `Turing.writeAdvTM` leaves the head after the word and returns to its
  own start state, which is the round shape of `Turing.counterLoopTM`; it is
  the round of `Turing.expandTM` (R8.6). A seam consumer that calls it once
  uses `Turing.seamReleaseTM`.
* **Tables** are written with the catalog's one-tape actions
  `Turing.tapeAction` and `Turing.inputMoveAction`.
* **The input sweeps** move the native input head and return it to position
  `1`. `Turing.inputCopyTM` moves the destination work head in lockstep with
  it; `Turing.inputFoldTM` moves only the input head, so its work heads stay
  fixed. `Turing.inputCopyTM` reuses the sweep
  alphabet `Turing.SweepPhase` and `Turing.inputFoldTM` the scan alphabet
  `Turing.ScanPhase`, so no phase type is duplicated.
* **The input fold is the validator** of design §12.8a §0: a rich
  space-bounded simulator folds its input through `decodeBool`'s domain first
  and stops on a foreign symbol, because `alphabet_reduction_spaceUsed` bounds
  space over all rich inputs (decision O6).

## Main definitions

* `Turing.WritePhase`, `Turing.writeConstTM` — write a fixed word and return.
* `Turing.writeAdvTM` — write a fixed word and leave the head after it.
* `Turing.inputCopyTM` — copy the native input onto a work tape.
* `Turing.inputFoldTM` — fold the native input with a finite-state update.

## Main results

* `Turing.writeConstTM_run_ofCfg`, `Turing.writeAdvTM_run_ofCfg`,
  `Turing.inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg`, `Turing.inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg` — the framed
  contracts (proved).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2: the k-tape model with a read-only
  input tape; the routines are folklore subroutines of the textbook's
  simulations. §4.1: the space measure that makes input validation necessary
  for the rich simulators.)
-/

namespace Turing

/-- A partially written word, with its arbitrary exterior frame preserved. The three
writing rows share this family; `r` counts written cells, `q` is the control state,
and `p` is the native-input position. -/
private def scanWriteCfg {Symbol S : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol S x) (q : S)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol S x :=
  { d with state := some q
           inputPos := p
           workTapes := fun j z =>
             if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (r : ℤ)
               then FinTM.bufferTape w (z - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j z
           workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) else 0 }

/-- Writing the next symbol and moving right extends the shared written prefix.

**Proof sketch.** Cite the public writing-step equation. On the selected tape,
`catalog_write_take` extends the overwrite interval by one cell; all other tapes
are fixed, and the selected head advances by one. -/
private theorem scan_write_step {Symbol S : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol S x)
    (q q' : S) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (inp : SignType) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length)
    (htr : M.tr q (scanWriteCfg i w d q p r).inputSymbol
        (scanWriteCfg i w d q p r).workTapeSymbols =
      tapeAction i inp (some (some w[r])) .pos q') :
    M.step (scanWriteCfg i w d q p r) =
      scanWriteCfg i w d q' (moveInputPos p inp) (r + 1) := by
  rw [step_of_tapeAction_write M _ i inp _ .pos rfl htr]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case workTapes =>
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa [scanWriteCfg] using catalog_write_take (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i) w r hr
    · simp [scanWriteCfg, hj]
  case workTapePos =>
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i <;>
      simp [scanWriteCfg, hj, Function.update_apply, SignType.cast] <;> omega
  all_goals simp [scanWriteCfg]

/-! ### R8.4 — the constant writer -/

/-- **Phase alphabet of the constant writer** (design §12.8a, R8.4), for a word
of length `n`: writing cell `j`, walking back with `j` cells to go, and the
live exit anchor. -/
inductive WritePhase (n : ℕ) where
  /-- writing cell `j` of the word -/
  | wr (j : Fin (n + 1))
  /-- walking back, `j` cells from the origin -/
  | bk (j : Fin (n + 1))
  /-- the live exit anchor -/
  | done
deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- **R8.4, the constant writer** (design §12.8a). Write the fixed word `w₀` on
tape `i` from its head, moving right, then walk back `|w₀|` cells and enter the
live `done` anchor with the head where it started. The old contents of the
tape are never read. -/
def writeConstTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) :
    MultiTapeTM k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) where
  q₀ := .wr 0
  tr := fun q _ _ =>
    match q with
    | .wr j =>
      if h : (j : ℕ) < w₀.length then
        tapeAction i 0 (some (some w₀[(j : ℕ)])) .pos (.wr ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩)
      else inputMoveAction 0 (.bk ⟨w₀.length, by omega⟩)
    | .bk j =>
      if (j : ℕ) = 0 then inputMoveAction 0 .done
      else tapeAction i 0 none .neg (.bk ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩)
    | .done => inputMoveAction 0 .done

/-- The constant writer after `r` forward steps, with a total finite-state index. -/
private def scanConstF {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w.length) x) (r : ℕ) :
    Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w.length) x :=
  scanWriteCfg i w d (.wr ⟨min r w.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos r

/-- The constant writer's return configuration, `r` cells to the right of entry. -/
private def scanConstR {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w.length) x) (r : ℕ) :
    Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w.length) x :=
  { scanWriteCfg i w d (.bk ⟨min r w.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos w.length with
      workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) else 0 }

/-- The constant writer's exit, with the entire word written and all heads restored. -/
private def scanConstD {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w.length) x) :
    Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w.length) x :=
  { d with state := some .done
           workTapes := (scanConstF i w d w.length).workTapes }

/-- The constant writer instantiates the public two-pass trace.

**Proof sketch.** The shared write step supplies the forward equations. A stationary
turn enters the return family; left moves count down to zero; a stationary entry
reaches the fixed exit. The public trace theorem supplies the whole run. -/
private theorem scan_const_trace {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w.length) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.wr 0)) (t : ℕ) :
    (writeConstTM k i w).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (scanConstF i w d) (scanConstR i w d) (scanConstD i w d) w.length t := by
  have h0 : scanConstF i w d 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext
    case workTapes => funext j z; simp [scanConstF, scanWriteCfg]
    all_goals simp [scanConstF, scanWriteCfg, hstate]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h0]
  apply catalog_trace_run
  · intro r hr
    unfold scanConstF
    simpa only [moveInputPos_zero] using
      scan_write_step (writeConstTM k i w) i w d (.wr ⟨min r w.length, by omega⟩)
        (.wr ⟨min (r + 1) w.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos 0 r hr (by
          simp only [writeConstTM]
          rw [dif_pos (show min r w.length < w.length by omega)]
          simp only [show min r w.length = r by omega]
          congr 2
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
          omega)
  · rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl
      (q' := .bk ⟨min w.length w.length, by omega⟩) (by
        simp only [writeConstTM]
        rw [dif_neg (show ¬ min w.length w.length < w.length by omega)]
        simp)]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [scanConstF, scanConstR, scanWriteCfg]
  · intro r hr
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move _ _ i 0 .neg rfl
      (q' := .bk ⟨min r w.length, by omega⟩) (by
        simp only [writeConstTM]
        rw [if_neg (show ¬ min (r + 1) w.length = 0 by omega)]
        congr 2
        apply Fin.ext
        simp
        omega)]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;>
        simp [scanConstR, scanWriteCfg, hj, Function.update_apply] <;> omega
    all_goals simp [scanConstR, scanWriteCfg]
  · rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl (q' := .done) (by simp [writeConstTM])]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [scanConstR, scanConstD, scanConstF, scanWriteCfg]
  · rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl (q' := .done) rfl]
    simp [scanConstD]

/-- **R8.4, the constant writer, framed** (design §12.8a). From any
configuration at the writer's start phase, the writer reaches `done` at
exactly `2|w₀| + 2` and not earlier. At that point the interval
`[pos, pos + |w₀|)` of tape `i` holds `w₀`, whatever it held before, and every
other cell, the head positions, the input position and the output are
unchanged. Up to the exit the head of tape `i` stays within
`[pos, pos + |w₀|]`, and every other head is fixed.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the cells written: `|w₀|` steps write `w₀` moving
right. One stationary step turns into the walk back, `|w₀|` steps return the
head to `pos`, and one stationary step enters `done`. No step reads a work
cell, so the old contents are irrelevant. -/
theorem writeConstTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.wr 0)) :
    (writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d (2 * w₀.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape w₀ (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w₀.length + 2, ((writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w₀.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ))
        else ((writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [scan_const_trace i w₀ d hstate]
    simp [catalogTrace, scanConstD, scanConstF, scanWriteCfg,
      show ¬2 * w₀.length + 2 ≤ w₀.length by omega]
  · intro t ht
    rw [scan_const_trace i w₀ d hstate]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [scanConstF, scanConstR, scanConstD, scanWriteCfg] <;> omega
  · intro j t ht
    rw [scan_const_trace i w₀ d hstate]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;>
      simp_all [scanConstF, scanConstR, scanConstD, scanWriteCfg, Finset.mem_Icc] <;> omega

/-! ### R8.4′ — the advancing writer -/

/-- **R8.4′, the advancing writer** (design §12.8a). Write the fixed word `w₀`
on tape `i` from its head, moving right, and return to the start state `0` with
the head just after the word. The state `j` is the number of cells written. The
writer is cyclic: started again, it writes `w₀` again after the first copy,
which makes it a round body of `Turing.counterLoopTM` with anchor `0`. -/
def writeAdvTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) :
    MultiTapeTM k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1)) where
  q₀ := 0
  tr := fun j _ _ =>
    if h : (j : ℕ) < w₀.length then
      tapeAction i 0 (some (some w₀[(j : ℕ)])) .pos ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩
    else inputMoveAction 0 0

/-- The advancing writer after `r` writes; its finite state counts the written cells. -/
private def scanAdvF {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w.length + 1)) x) (r : ℕ) :
    Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w.length + 1)) x :=
  scanWriteCfg i w d ⟨min r w.length, by omega⟩ d.inputPos r

/-- Up to the word length, the advancing writer follows the shared write family.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of written cells, invoking `scan_write_step`
at each successor. This is a single forward induction: the cyclic exit is not
stationary, so the two-pass trace theorem does not apply. -/
private theorem scan_adv_run {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w.length + 1)) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some 0) :
    ∀ r ≤ w.length, (writeAdvTM k i w).runFrom d r = scanAdvF i w d r := by
  intro r hr
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    apply Cfg.ext
    case workTapes => funext j z; simp [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg]
    all_goals simp [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg, hstate]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    unfold scanAdvF
    simpa only [moveInputPos_zero] using
      scan_write_step (writeAdvTM k i w) i w d ⟨min r w.length, by omega⟩
        ⟨min (r + 1) w.length, by omega⟩ d.inputPos 0 r (by omega) (by
          simp only [writeAdvTM]
          rw [dif_pos (show min r w.length < w.length by omega)]
          simp only [show min r w.length = r by omega]
          congr 1
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
          omega)

/-- **R8.4′, the advancing writer, framed** (design §12.8a). From any
configuration at state `0`, the writer returns to state `0` at exactly
`|w₀| + 1`, and its states strictly between are not `0`. At that point the
interval `[pos, pos + |w₀|)` of tape `i` holds `w₀`, whatever it held before,
the head of tape `i` is at `pos + |w₀|`, and every other cell, every other
head, the input position and the output are unchanged. Up to the return the
head of tape `i` stays within `[pos, pos + |w₀|]`, and every other head is
fixed. These are exactly the round hypotheses of `Turing.counterLoopTM_run_done`
with round time `|w₀| + 1`.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the cells written: the state after `j ≤ |w₀|` steps
is `j`, which is nonzero for `0 < j`, with `j` cells of `w₀` written and the
head at `pos + j`. The last step is stationary and returns to `0`. No step
reads a work cell. -/
theorem writeAdvTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1)) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some 0) :
    (writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d (w₀.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some 0
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape w₀ (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i + (w₀.length : ℤ)) } ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → t < w₀.length + 1 → ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w₀.length + 1 →
        if j = i then
          ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ))
        else ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  have hlast : (writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d (w₀.length + 1) =
      { scanAdvF i w₀ d w₀.length with state := some 0 } := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', scan_adv_run i w₀ d hstate _ le_rfl]
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl (q' := 0) (by
      simp only [writeAdvTM]
      rw [dif_neg (show ¬ min w₀.length w₀.length < w₀.length by omega)])]
    simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hlast]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j; simp [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg]
      · simp [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg, hj]
    all_goals simp [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg]
  · intro t ht0 ht
    rw [scan_adv_run i w₀ d hstate t (by omega)]
    simp only [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero]
    omega
  · intro j t ht
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t (w₀.length + 1) with h | h
    · rw [scan_adv_run i w₀ d hstate t (by omega)]
      split_ifs with hj <;> simp [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg, hj, Finset.mem_Icc] <;> omega
    · rw [show t = w₀.length + 1 by omega, hlast]
      split_ifs with hj <;> simp [scanAdvF, scanWriteCfg, hj, Finset.mem_Icc]

/-! ### R8.5a — the input copier -/

/-- **R8.5a, the input copier** (design §12.8a). Copy the native input onto
tape `i` from its head, the two heads moving right in lockstep, then walk both
heads back together, guided by the input tape's left end marker. The phases are
the sweep alphabet's: `sweep` copies, `rewind` returns, and `done` is the live
exit anchor. The destination needs no left delimiter. -/
def inputCopyTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase where
  q₀ := .sweep
  tr := fun q inp _ =>
    match q with
    | .sweep =>
      match inp with
      | some s => tapeAction i 1 (some (some s)) .pos .sweep
      | none => tapeAction i (-1) none .neg .rewind
    | .rewind =>
      match inp with
      | some _ => tapeAction i (-1) none .neg .rewind
      | none => tapeAction i 1 none .pos .done
    | .done => inputMoveAction 0 .done

/-- The copier after `r` forward steps, with the input and destination heads advanced. -/
private def scanCopyF {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x :=
  scanWriteCfg i x d .sweep ⟨min r x.length + 1, by omega⟩ r

/-- The copier's return family, indexed by native-input position down to zero. -/
private def scanCopyR {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x :=
  { scanWriteCfg i x d .rewind ⟨min r x.length, by omega⟩ x.length with
      workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0 }

/-- The copier's exit restores both heads while retaining the copied input. -/
private def scanCopyD {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x :=
  { d with state := some .done
           workTapes := (scanCopyF i d x.length).workTapes }

/-- The native-input copier instantiates the public two-pass trace.

**Proof sketch.** Interior input reads supply the symbols for the shared write
step. The right marker turns both heads left, interior reads guide the return,
and the left marker moves both heads right into the fixed exit. No destination
delimiter is used. Apply the public trace theorem to these five equations. -/
private theorem scan_copy_trace {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some .sweep) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    (inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (scanCopyF i d) (scanCopyR i d) (scanCopyD i d) x.length t := by
  have h0 : scanCopyF i d 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos => rw [hin]; apply Fin.ext; simp [scanCopyF, scanWriteCfg]
    case workTapes => funext j z; simp [scanCopyF, scanWriteCfg]
    all_goals simp [scanCopyF, scanWriteCfg, hstate]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h0]
  apply catalog_trace_run
  · intro r hr
    have hs : (scanCopyF i d r).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
      inputSymbolInner r (by simp [scanCopyF, scanWriteCfg]; omega) hr
    unfold scanCopyF
    rw [scan_write_step (inputCopyTM k i) i x d .sweep .sweep _ 1 r hr
      (by
        change (inputCopyTM k i).tr .sweep (scanCopyF i d r).inputSymbol
          (scanCopyF i d r).workTapeSymbols = _
        simp only [inputCopyTM, hs])]
    congr 1
    rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
    omega
  · have hs : (scanCopyF i d x.length).inputSymbol = none := by
      apply Cfg.inputSymbol_of_end
      simp [scanCopyF, scanWriteCfg]
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move _ _ i (-1) .neg rfl (q' := .rewind)
      (by simp only [inputCopyTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [scanCopyF, scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg]
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
      simp
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;>
        simp [scanCopyF, scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg, hj, Function.update_apply] <;> omega
    all_goals simp [scanCopyF, scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg]
  · intro r hr
    have hs : (scanCopyR i d (r + 1)).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
      inputSymbolInner r (by simp [scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg]; omega) hr
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move _ _ i (-1) .neg rfl (q' := .rewind)
      (by simp only [inputCopyTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg]
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
      simp
      omega
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;>
        simp [scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg, hj, Function.update_apply] <;> omega
    all_goals simp [scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg]
  · have hs : (scanCopyR i d 0).inputSymbol = none := by
      apply Cfg.inputSymbol_of_zero
      simp [scanCopyR, scanWriteCfg]
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move _ _ i 1 .pos rfl (q' := .done)
      (by simp only [inputCopyTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [scanCopyR, scanCopyD, scanWriteCfg, hin]
      rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp)]
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;>
        simp [scanCopyR, scanCopyD, scanWriteCfg, hj, Function.update_apply]
    all_goals simp [scanCopyR, scanCopyD, scanCopyF, scanWriteCfg]
  · rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl (q' := .done) rfl]
    simp [scanCopyD]

/-- **R8.5a, the input copier, framed** (design §12.8a). From any configuration
in the copy phase with the input head at position `1`, the copier reaches
`done` at exactly `2|x| + 2` and not earlier, where `x` is the native input. At
that point the interval `[pos, pos + |x|)` of tape `i` holds `x`, whatever it
held before, and every other cell, every head, the input position and the
output are unchanged. Up to the exit the head of tape `i` stays within
`[pos - 1, pos + |x|]`, and every other head is fixed.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the input cells: `|x|` lockstep steps copy `x`,
and the input's right end marker turns both heads left. The return takes `|x|`
lockstep steps over the input, and the left end marker supplies the entry step,
which puts the input head back at `1` and the work head back at `pos`. -/
theorem inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (x.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape x (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, ((inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (x.length : ℤ))
        else ((inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [scan_copy_trace i d hstate hin]
    simp [catalogTrace, scanCopyD, scanCopyF, scanWriteCfg,
      show ¬2 * x.length + 2 ≤ x.length by omega]
  · intro t ht
    rw [scan_copy_trace i d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [scanCopyF, scanCopyR, scanCopyD, scanWriteCfg] <;> omega
  · intro j t ht
    rw [scan_copy_trace i d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;>
      simp_all [scanCopyF, scanCopyR, scanCopyD, scanWriteCfg, Finset.mem_Icc] <;> omega

/-! ### R8.5d — the input fold -/

/-- **R8.5d, the input fold** (design §12.8a). Read the native input left to
right, updating a finite state by `δ` from `a₀`, then walk the input head back
and enter the live anchor `done a` with the final state `a` as the verdict.
No work tape is touched. With `δ` testing membership in the image of an
embedding, it is the input validator of design §12.8a §0. -/
def inputFoldTM {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} (k : ℕ) (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) :
    MultiTapeTM k Γ (ScanPhase A) where
  q₀ := .fwd a₀
  tr := fun q inp _ =>
    match q with
    | .fwd a =>
      match inp with
      | some γ => inputMoveAction 1 (.fwd (δ a γ))
      | none => inputMoveAction (-1) (.bwd a)
    | .bwd a =>
      match inp with
      | some _ => inputMoveAction (-1) (.bwd a)
      | none => inputMoveAction 1 (.done a)
    | .done a => inputMoveAction 0 (.done a)

/-- In the backward phase a symbol read requests a left move and keeps the
backward state. A blank read requests a right move and enters the live completed
state. Both rows preserve the accumulator and ignore the work-tape reads. -/
theorem inputFoldTM_tr_bwd {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} (k : ℕ)
    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ a : A) (inp : Option Γ) (work : Fin k → Option Γ) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).tr (.bwd a) inp work =
      (match inp with
       | some _ => inputMoveAction (-1) (.bwd a)
       | none => inputMoveAction 1 (.done a)) := by
  rfl

/-- The native fold's forward accumulator and input position after `r` reads. -/
private def scanFoldF {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (r : ℕ) :
    Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x :=
  { d with state := some (.fwd ((x.take r).foldl δ a₀))
           inputPos := ⟨min r x.length + 1, by omega⟩ }

/-- The native fold's return keeps the completed accumulator and counts input positions down. -/
private def scanFoldR {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (r : ℕ) :
    Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x :=
  { d with state := some (.bwd (x.foldl δ a₀))
           inputPos := ⟨min r x.length, by omega⟩ }

/-- The native fold is an instance of the public two-pass trace, with untouched work tapes.

**Proof sketch.** Interior input reads extend the prefix fold by one symbol. The
right marker changes to the backward phase without changing the final accumulator.
The return passes over the input and enters the fixed verdict at its left marker.
All five equations cite the public input-only step lemma. -/
private theorem scan_fold_trace {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (scanFoldF δ a₀ d) (scanFoldR δ a₀ d)
        { d with state := some (.done (x.foldl δ a₀)) } x.length t := by
  have h0 : scanFoldF δ a₀ d 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [scanFoldF, hstate, hin]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h0]
  apply catalog_trace_run
  · intro r hr
    have hs : (scanFoldF δ a₀ d r).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
      inputSymbolInner r (by simp [scanFoldF]; omega) hr
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 1 rfl
      (q' := .fwd (δ ((x.take r).foldl δ a₀) x[r])) (by simp only [inputFoldTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case state =>
      simp only [scanFoldF]
      rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr, List.foldl_append]
      rfl
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [scanFoldF]
      rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp; omega)]
      simp
      omega
    all_goals simp [scanFoldF]
  · have hs : (scanFoldF δ a₀ d x.length).inputSymbol = none := by
      apply Cfg.inputSymbol_of_end
      simp [scanFoldF]
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ (-1) rfl
      (q' := .bwd ((x.take x.length).foldl δ a₀)) (by simp only [inputFoldTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [scanFoldF, scanFoldR]
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
      simp
    all_goals simp [scanFoldF, scanFoldR]
  · intro r hr
    have hs : (scanFoldR δ a₀ d (r + 1)).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
      inputSymbolInner r (by simp [scanFoldR]; omega) hr
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ (-1) rfl
      (q' := .bwd (x.foldl δ a₀)) (by simp only [inputFoldTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [scanFoldR]
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
      simp
      omega
    all_goals simp [scanFoldR]
  · have hs : (scanFoldR δ a₀ d 0).inputSymbol = none := by
      apply Cfg.inputSymbol_of_zero
      simp [scanFoldR]
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 1 rfl
      (q' := .done (x.foldl δ a₀)) (by simp only [inputFoldTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [scanFoldR, hin]
      rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp)]
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
    all_goals simp [scanFoldR]
  · rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl (q' := .done (x.foldl δ a₀)) rfl]
    simp

/-- **R8.5d, the input fold, framed** (design §12.8a). From any configuration
in the forward phase at `a₀` with the input head at position `1`, the fold
reaches `done (x.foldl δ a₀)` at exactly `2|x| + 2`, where `x` is the native
input, and no `done` anchor earlier. Nothing else changes: the finish is the
start configuration with only the control state replaced, so the input head is
back at `1`. Up to the exit no work head moves.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the input cells: after `j ≤ |x|` forward steps the
state is the fold of the first `j` symbols and the input head is at `j + 1`.
The right end marker turns the head, `|x|` steps return it, and the left end
marker supplies the entry step. -/
theorem inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
        { d with state := some (.done (x.foldl δ a₀)) } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2 →
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [scan_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp [catalogTrace, show ¬2 * x.length + 2 ≤ x.length by omega]
  · intro t ht a
    rw [scan_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [scanFoldF, scanFoldR] <;> omega
  · intro j t _
    rw [scan_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [scanFoldF, scanFoldR]

end Turing
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Seam.lean =====

```
/-
